name: mcp-app-sample
description: Kitchen-sink MCP server demonstrating core protocol + MCP Apps (SEP-1865) capabilities, plus a verification harness.

scripts.build:views: cross-env INPUT=dashboard.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=shader.html vite build && cross-env INPUT=counter.html vite build
scripts.build: npm run build:views && npm run build:server
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run serve:http
scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently --raw "cross-env INPUT=dashboard.html vite build --watch" "cross-env INPUT=shader.html vite build --watch" "cross-env INPUT=counter.html vite build --watch" "tsx watch main.ts"
